Thanks Ethan — received. A few clarifying items from our side before we trigger the verification: 

- Legal name match: the bank letter shows "Altius Systems, Inc." — that matches our vendor record (thanks). If you can also attach the W-9 we will store the EIN for tax purposes.
- Micro-deposits: we typically post two small ACH credits (two cents-level amounts) and ask that you confirm amounts within 5 business days. Can you confirm who on your side will look for them and the expected posting window?
- PO mapping: we can map the invoice header field "PO#" to our internal PO reference. Please confirm whether the PO on your invoices will always be prefixed (e.g., "PO: 12345") or if it may appear as just a number. If inconsistent, include a sample invoice.
- Currency & wire fallback: confirm USD and whether to use wires only if ACH fails. Also confirm remittance email for automated receipts — we'll send a notice when payment clears.

I attached our vendor onboarding checklist (payment_onboarding_checklist.pdf) with the exact CSV schema we need for automated reconciliation. If you can fill that and return, it will speed things up.

Once we have the W-9 + confirmation of the micro-deposit recipient, we'll schedule the micro-deposit for next business day.

- Attached is a small CSV example that shows how we write the remittance reference back to your ledger: redwood_po_mapping_example.csv (see column "remit_ref_value").
